I administer Oracle Database and Oracle E-Business Suite environments
across development, test, and production, supporting installation,
configuration, deployment, cloning, patching, upgrades, and migrations.

My experience spans Oracle Database 10g–19c, Oracle EBS 12.1.x and
12.2.x, multi-node RAC clusters, non-RAC databases, and multitenant
architectures on Linux and Solaris.

My focus is on reliable operations, application compatibility, security,
performance, and keeping environments aligned with support and
maintenance requirements.

| Area | Experience |

| Oracle Database | Oracle Database 10g–19c |

| Service delivery | ServiceNow, incident management, SLA tracking, and client reporting |

## Database Administration and Lifecycle Management

I manage database environments throughout their operational lifecycle,
from initial installation and configuration to ongoing maintenance,
upgrades, and migrations.

My responsibilities include:

- Administering multi-node Oracle RAC clusters and non-RAC databases.
- Supporting multitenant environments using container databases and
  pluggable databases.
- Executing database cloning, patching, upgrades, and migrations across
  development, test, and production.
- Managing database users, access privileges, and tablespaces.
- Performing data import/export operations and schema refreshes.
- Coordinating changes with application and infrastructure teams to
  maintain compatibility and operational continuity.

## Oracle E-Business Suite Administration

I support Oracle EBS 12.1.x and 12.2.x environments, covering application
maintenance, access administration, cloning, and operational support.

### Cloning, Patching, and Maintenance

- Performed EBS cloning and patching activities.
- Managed patch merging in EBS 12.1.x environments.
- Conducted pre-patch analysis and coordinated client approvals before
  applying changes.
- Used Oracle AD utilities, including `adadmin`, `adctrl`, `adpatch`,
  and `adsplice`, as appropriate to the environment and maintenance task.
- Used `adop` for online patching activities in EBS 12.2.x environments.

### Application Operations and Access Controls

- Administered user accounts, responsibilities, menus, and profile options.
- Supported Oracle Workflow and Concurrent Manager operations.
- Managed application password resets using `FNDCPASS`.
- Maintained appropriate application access controls and supported
  security-related administration.

## Automation and Operational Improvements

I develop automation to reduce repetitive administration, standardize
execution, and make routine operations easier to monitor.

### Weekly Database Cloning Automation

I developed a menu-driven workflow for weekly database cloning,
bringing related operations into a centralized execution process.

| Measure | Result |
|:--|--:|
| Execution time before automation | Approximately 11 hours |
| Execution time after automation | Approximately 6.5 hours |
| Time saved per weekly execution | Approximately 4.5 hours |
| Execution-time reduction | Approximately 41% |

The workflow reduced manual intervention and opportunities for execution
errors while improving consistency across repeated cloning activities.

### Automated Health Checks and Reporting

- Automated daily health checks and reporting using Python scripts and
  Ansible playbooks.
- Designed KPI dashboards and automated reports to improve monitoring
  visibility.
- Prepared and delivered monthly system health reports to multiple clients.
- Automated recurring housekeeping activities to reduce manual overhead.

## Performance Monitoring and Workload Optimization

I monitor database and operating-system performance to identify
bottlenecks, investigate long-running workloads, and support business SLAs.

My work includes:

- Tuning long-running jobs and Control-M workflows to reduce execution
  time and improve throughput.
- Investigating SQL performance and applying query-tuning improvements.
- Rebuilding indexes and reorganizing tables where appropriate to the
  identified issue.
- Generating and analyzing AWR, ADDM, and Statspack reports.
- Monitoring cluster health and resource utilization.
- Using `sar`, `top`, and `vmstat` to investigate system activity and
  resource constraints.
- Applying corrective measures and reviewing their effect on workloads.

## Backup, Recovery, and Availability

I support recovery readiness and availability through backup management,
recovery operations, standby configuration, and incident investigation.

### RMAN Backup and Recovery

- Managed RMAN backups across database environments.
- Performed complete and incomplete database recovery.
- Supported database restoration and recovery requirements.
- Managed schema refreshes and data movement between environments.

### Active Data Guard

Configured Active Data Guard to support recovery point objective
(RPO) and recovery time objective (RTO) requirements.

The focus was on aligning standby configuration and recovery planning
with the business's availability and disaster-recovery needs.

### Incident Analysis and Long-Term Remediation

Performed root cause analysis on recurring incidents and implemented
long-term fixes to improve resilience and reduce repeat disruptions.

This included investigating database behavior, reviewing resource
utilization, and coordinating corrective actions across technical teams.

I support Oracle APEX administration and environment synchronization.

- Created and administered APEX workspaces and users.

My responsibilities include:
